title: Dynasplint for Distal Radius Fracture
brief_summary: The purpose of this study was to examine the efficacy of dynamic splinting as a therapeutic modality in reducing contracture following surgical treatment of distal radius fractures.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Distal radius fracture treated with surgical management and wrist flexion contracture upon follow up

Exclusion Criteria:

* Carpal Fractures (Scaphoid, Lunate, Hamate, and Trapezium)
* Radial nerve entrapment
* Arthrodesis
* Traumatic dislocation of the distal ulna
